focus: Render-evidence provenance and false-PASS prevention for the 100-point Visual Fidelity Gate

implementationReadiness.reason: The remaining seven readiness points require an actual Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile/runner verification artifact. Source-side provenance work does not satisfy that runtime requirement.

visualFidelity.reason: Assets/QA/Captures4K is absent on the branch and 4k_capture_manifest.json remains a non-runtime template until Unity executes the native capture path. No observable render property was self-scored.

problemFound.finding: The existing numeric evaluator checked that image paths existed, but did not cryptographically bind visual_fidelity_evidence.json to the exact Unity-generated 4K manifest/render bytes and did not independently prove that claimed 100% crops were pixel-identical source-frame regions.
problemFound.risk: A manually authored or stale evidence file could potentially point at unrelated/replaced PNGs and reach numeric evaluation, conflicting with the automatic FAIL rule against claiming render quality without an actual render.

implemented: Added a supported Capture + Seal path that runs QualityBlock4KCapture, extracts existing rooftop observability crops, validates runtime manifest metadata, then SHA-256 seals the manifest and every required hero/oblique/grazing full frame and manifest crop.
Added captureSessionId plus a byte-identity receipt at Assets/QA/render_capture_receipt.json when a real Unity capture exists.
Added a bound review-template generator that records captureSessionId, manifest SHA-256 and receipt SHA-256 while remaining renderVerified=false and unscored until explicit review.
Added evidence-bound scoring that requires reviewed evidence hashes/session/version/frame paths/crop sets to match the sealed current render set before calling the existing 100-point numeric gate.

Added decoded Color32 1:1 crop verification: every crop texel must equal the corresponding native 3840x2160 source-frame texel; any mismatch, resample, sharpen, stale/replaced crop or altered post-seal bytes fails provenance.

Disabled the legacy unbound Visual Fidelity editor menu entry. The machine-readable contract forbids automation/CI/CLI from directly calling the legacy evaluator and names the evidence-bound evaluator as the supported path.
Kept provenance/capture validation separate from Visual Fidelity scoring; successful sealing or provenance validation awards zero visual points.

compare.scope: Both changed files are under UnityProject; no Godot file changed.

verification.note: The new crop/hash checks are implemented but intentionally remain unexecuted until Unity produces real runtime files. No simulated evidence was generated to make them pass.

expectedVisualScoreImpact: No direct category points are awarded from this source-only run.
Critical-defect risk is reduced across all 100 points because future numeric scoring is bound to the exact sealed Unity render set rather than arbitrary file existence.

Temporal/LOD, lighting/reflection, material response, texture microdetail and geometry deductions can no longer be silently carried over after the underlying render bytes change; a changed frame/crop invalidates the receipt and forces re-review.
The true-100%-crop check strengthens scrutiny of fine rail/sash/foliage aliasing, microdetail and contact defects without permitting resampling or sharpening to hide them.
nextBlocker: Unity 6000.3.0f1 editor/runner compile plus the first real native 3840x2160 hero/oblique/grazing capture. When it appears, stop speculative scene expansion, use CaptureAndSealNative4KEvidence, review the exact sealed frames and 100% crops, populate the bound evidence document, run EvaluateEvidenceBoundVisualGate, and fix observed deductions/critical defects before adding new detail.
